## Checklist

- [ ] A test failed before the change and passes after it (each expected value states its source).
- [ ] Generated files were not edited by hand; after a generator or `overrides.json` change, `npm run generate` was run and its output is committed.
- [ ] New public symbols are in `src/Graspea.Flint/PublicAPI.Unshipped.txt`.
- [ ] README code blocks and their `#region readme:` copies in `ReadmeExamplesTests.cs` still match.
- [ ] Commits have short imperative English subjects and no co-author trailers.
